sentence: Texticular dysfunction cannot guide a babay through a door they must read themselves.

wombos.definition: A baby gay — someone newly exploring or embracing their queer identity, still in the early, tender stages of that journey.
wombos.example: She just came out last month — total babay, and thriving.

wombos.definition: A self-diagnosed condition of strongly preferring to have text read aloud rather than reading it yourself. A play on "testicular dysfunction."
wombos.example: I've got severe texticular dysfunction — just let the app read it to me.
